tweets.html: Astros bench coach Omar López said manager Joe Espada “had probably one of the worst nights of his life last night.” López said he spoke to Espada briefly and that he is “heartbroken.” Espada will accompany the team to New York for its upcoming road trip, López said.

tweets.html: There has never been a full season that a team with a losing record has reached the postseason in MLB history.There are only 4 teams with winning records in the American League.Bob Nightengale (@BNightengale)The AL West does not have a single team with a winning record.The Houston Astros and Texas Rangers are tied for first place with a 65-66 record.The division has been outscored by a whopping 391 runs.—  https://x.com/BNightengale/status/2091638580707750044

tweets.author: Chandler Rome
tweets.html: The Astros lost 7-6. They are 65-66.The Astros blew a 6-0 lead against the A's, who have baseball's worst record. They went 3-6 on a nine-game homestand against the Mariners, Angels and A's. They will, somehow, remain in first place in the AL West via tiebreaker. It is bad.

tweets.author: Brian McTaggart
tweets.html: This is as bad as it gets for the Astros, who blew a 6-run lead & lost to the A's, 7-6, to fall back under .500.The Astros went 3-6 on a homestand against the Mariners, Angels and A's, losing 2 of three 3 to each. Now 20 of their final 31 games are against teams in contention.
